_format: version = newest released launcher version, url = its download page/installer, notes = optional short changelog.
notes: The Item Shop now carries the full Fortnite cosmetic catalog: 16,788 outfits, emotes, harvesting tools, gliders, back blings, wraps, contrails, sprays, emojis, loading screens, jam tracks, toys, kicks, auras and banners. The rotation changes every 24 hours, and holiday days automatically replace normal stock with that holiday's own themed items.
